# googleworkspace_gmail_user_settings (Resource)

Gmail User Settings resource manages the IMAP, POP and automatic forwarding settings of one Gmail user mailbox. Only the setting blocks that are in the configuration are managed. The provider impersonates the mailbox owner with domain-wide delegation. The IMAP and POP settings need the `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.settings.basic` client scope. The automatic forwarding setting also needs the `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.settings.sharing` client scope. Both scopes are in the default `oauth_scopes` of the provider. Gmail settings cannot be deleted: a destroy only removes the resource from the Terraform state and does not change the mailbox. An import reads all three setting blocks. If the configuration does not have a block, the next apply removes that block from the state and does not change the mailbox. If the provider credentials cannot impersonate the user, Gmail rejects the requests and the mailbox is not changed. If a refresh finds that the user does not exist (the token exchange fails with `invalid_grant` and "Invalid email or User ID"), the resource is removed from the state. This covers service account key credentials and `access_token` with `service_account`. Other errors, including a 404 from Gmail, fail the refresh and keep the resource in the state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

# Disable IMAP, POP and automatic forwarding for one mailbox
# (CIS Google Workspace Foundations controls on POP/IMAP access and automatic forwarding).
# This is the setting of one mailbox, not the admin setting that controls
# whether users can forward mail. It does not stop forwarding by Gmail filters.
resource "googleworkspace_gmail_user_settings" "restricted" {
  user_email = "user@example.com"

  imap {
    enabled = false
  }

  pop {
    access_window = "disabled"
  }

  auto_forwarding {
    enabled = false
  }
}

# Manage only the IMAP settings of a mailbox. The POP and automatic
# forwarding settings are not managed.
resource "googleworkspace_gmail_user_settings" "imap" {
  user_email = "another.user@example.com"

  imap {
    enabled          = true
    auto_expunge     = false
    expunge_behavior = "trash"
    max_folder_size  = 1000
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `user_email` (String) The primary email address of the mailbox owner. The provider impersonates this user.

### Optional

- `auto_forwarding` (Block List, Max: 1) The automatic forwarding settings of the mailbox. If this block is not set, the automatic forwarding settings are not managed. This is the setting of one mailbox, not the admin setting that controls whether users can forward mail. `enabled = false` does not stop forwarding by Gmail filters. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--auto_forwarding))
- `imap` (Block List, Max: 1) The IMAP settings of the mailbox. If this block is not set, the IMAP settings are not managed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--imap))
- `pop` (Block List, Max: 1) The POP settings of the mailbox. If this block is not set, the POP settings are not managed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--pop))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource. It is the same as `user_email`.

<a id="nestedblock--auto_forwarding"></a>
### Nested Schema for `auto_forwarding`

Required:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether Gmail automatically forwards all incoming mail to `email_address`.

Optional:

- `disposition` (String) The state of a message after Gmail forwards it. One of `leaveInInbox`, `archive`, `trash` or `markRead`. If not set, the current value is kept.
- `email_address` (String) The email address to which Gmail forwards all incoming mail. Required if `enabled` is `true`. The address must be a forwarding address of the mailbox with verification status `accepted`. Create it outside Terraform; addresses in the same domain may not require verification. If `enabled` is `false`, the provider does not read this value back from the API.


<a id="nestedblock--imap"></a>
### Nested Schema for `imap`

Required:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether IMAP is enabled for the mailbox.

Optional:

- `auto_expunge` (Boolean) If `true`, Gmail immediately expunges a message when it is marked as deleted in IMAP. If `false`, Gmail waits for an update from the client before it expunges messages marked as deleted. If not set, the current value is kept.
- `expunge_behavior` (String) The action on a message that is marked as deleted and expunged from the last visible IMAP folder. One of `archive`, `trash` or `deleteForever`. If not set, the current value is kept.
- `max_folder_size` (Number) The maximum number of messages that an IMAP folder can contain. One of `0`, `1000`, `2000`, `5000` or `10000`. `0` means no limit. If not set, the current value is kept.


<a id="nestedblock--pop"></a>
### Nested Schema for `pop`

Required:

- `access_window` (String) The range of messages that are accessible with POP. One of `disabled`, `fromNowOn` or `allMail`. Not verified: after a POP client fetches mail, Gmail can possibly read back `allMail` as a different value, and the plan then shows a change.

Optional:

- `disposition` (String) The action on a message after it is fetched with POP. One of `leaveInInbox`, `archive`, `trash` or `markRead`. If not set, the current value is kept.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

# The import ID is the email address of the mailbox owner.
# The import reads the IMAP, POP and automatic forwarding settings.
terraform import googleworkspace_gmail_user_settings.restricted user@example.com
```
